Chapter 402: Chapter 14 Stupid! (Subscribe please)_3

Fang Qing finished speaking and then turned to leave, walking towards the last of the examiners.

“Thirteen Peaks Master….” Feng Yu naturally had heard of the Thirteen Peaks Master, a top-class prodigy with exceptional brilliance in the Chikun Star Domain, a freak who stepped into the Seventh Rank before the age of a hundred.

At the same time, the Thirteen Peaks Master was the only disciple the Chikun Star Lord had taken in for ten thousand years.

In theory, Feng Yu should have been overjoyed to accept the invitation from the Thirteen Peaks Master.

It was just that before this, the Great Peak Master had also sent someone to invite him.

This made Feng Yu hesitate.

...

Although the Great Peak Master’s innate talent was not as good as that of the Thirteen Peaks Master.

But having stepped into the Eighth Layer not long ago, even if the Thirteen Peaks Master was extremely talented, who knows how long it would take to go from Seventh to Eighth Layer?

“The Thirteen Peaks Master is indeed a top-level prodigy, but he’s too young, how could he possibly know how to teach disciples?”

Feng Yu thought to himself:

“Moreover, the Thirteen Peaks Master has only invited me to become a peripheral member of the Thirteen Peaks, but the Great Peak Master promised that if I join the first peak, I would be an inner member right away, and it’s only a matter of time before becoming a core member.”

After weighing the options, Feng Yu ultimately decided to choose the Great Peak Master.

After all, one was at the Eighth Layer, the other at the Seventh.

One an inner core member, the other peripheral.

Most importantly, having experienced so many years, the Great Peak Master, who had deeply received the true teachings of the Chikun Star Lord, would certainly far exceed the Thirteen Peaks Master in teaching disciples.

…

Among the Red Pattern Examiners.

Mo Li sat cross-legged, being one of the thirteen Red Patterns, Mo Li was certain to be valued by a Peak Master.

At this moment, what Mo Li pondered was, which Peak Master would invite him.

Compared to Feng Yu, Mo Li’s background was much greater, and he had a precise analysis of the various Peak Masters.

“The Thirteen Peaks Master wishes to…” Fang Qing walked up to Mo Li.

“The Thirteen Peaks Master invites me?” Mo Li’s eyes lit up, and he felt an instant surge of elation in his heart.

He came from a Seventh Rank power of the Annan Star Alliance, specifically coming to the Chikun Star Domain to participate in the arena competition in hopes of joining the Red Kun Lineage.

After an analysis with the elders of his power, Mo Li knew that the best outcome within the Red Kun Lineage would be to become a disciple of the Chikun Star Lord, but that was unrealistic.

Apart from the Chikun Star Lord, the Seventh Rank Evolver in Mo Li’s power weighed the options and concluded that it was best to be under the youngest and least experienced Thirteen Peaks Master.

Although the Great Peak Master had entered the Eighth Layer earlier, given the Thirteen Peaks Master’s talent, ascending to the Eighth Layer was just a matter of time.

Furthermore, the Thirteen Peaks Master, being the beloved junior disciple of the Chikun Star Lord, might very well become the second Chikun Star Lord, an invincible existence at the Eighth Layer.

Thus.

The earlier he entered under the Thirteen Peaks Master, the more benefits he would obtain, a great opportunity.

…

After the ‘housekeepers’ of the various Peak Masters completed their invitations.

One by one, the Evolvers began walking towards the distant thirteen gates.

The thirteen gates, from the first to the thirteenth, respectively represented the first Peak Master to the thirteenth Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage.

Swish swish swish.

After all the examiners entered the gates, they were then transported to a pavilion.

“You didn’t choose the Thirteen Peaks Master?” Mo Li, with a joyful mind and spirit, had been placed under the Thirteen Peaks Master, only feeling a bright future ahead of him.

However, when he saw the ‘one’ character imprinted on Feng Yu’s sleeve, he immediately felt some astonishment.

The number on the sleeve represented the examiner’s choice; Mo Li’s sleeve was imprinted with ‘thirteen’.

But Mo Li remembered that Fang Qing, the housekeeper of the Thirteen Peaks, had invited Feng Yu. How come the other party had not joined the Thirteen Peaks?

“Lord Mo Li.” Upon seeing the Red Pattern Examiner addressing him, Feng Yu immediately responded with respectful posture, “I have chosen the Great Peak Master…”

“To give up the Thirteen Peaks Master… to choose the Great Peak Master…” Mo Li looked at Feng Yu somewhat surprised, then turned and walked away.

In his mind, he couldn’t help criticizing:

“Foolish!”
